label: kizuna_battle_a_01
text: Osu, new kid![VAR 0x0114(0024)]

label: kizuna_battle_a_02
text: Have you come out here to the schoolyard for\nsome training?![VAR 0x0114(0024)]

label: kizuna_battle_a_03a
text: Aha! I knew I could see a fighting spirit burning\nbehind those eyes of yours![VAR 0x0114(0024)]

label: kizuna_battle_a_03b
text: Ah! Sorry. That was a little rude of me to ask.\nI know the point of training isn’t to show off in\r\nfront of other people.[VAR 0x0114(0024)]

label: kizuna_battle_a_04
text: Why don’t we do a bit of running together here\nto get to know each other a little better?[VAR 0x0114(0024)]

label: kizuna_battle_a_05
text: Ready? Let’s go![VAR 0x0114(0024)]

label: kizuna_battle_a_system_01
text: You ran three laps around the schoolyard with\nMs. Dendra...

label: kizuna_battle_a_06
text: Phew! That really worked up a nice sweat![VAR 0x0114(0024)]

label: kizuna_battle_a_07
text: You’ve got a good pair of legs on ya, new kid![VAR 0x0114(0024)]

label: kizuna_battle_a_08
text: A good bout of training sure does make a body\nhungry, doesn’t it?[VAR 0x0114(0024)]

label: kizuna_battle_a_09
text: I’ll let you have one of my homemade\nsandwiches as my way of saying thanks for\r\nrunning with me today! Feed those muscles![VAR 0x0114(0024)]

label: kizuna_battle_a_system_02
text: Ms. Dendra’s sandwich was dry and had an odd\nsmell. The taste left much to be desired...

label: kizuna_battle_a_10
text: How was it? I hope it was tasty.[VAR 0x0114(0024)]

label: kizuna_battle_a_select_01
text: Uh, yeah, tasty...

label: kizuna_battle_a_select_02
text: Well, to be honest...

label: kizuna_battle_a_11
text: Sorry. I shouldn’t have asked you that. Heh...[VAR 0x0114(0024)]

label: kizuna_battle_a_12
text: I’m athletic and all, but I don’t know the first\nthing about making good food...[VAR 0x0114(0024)]

label: kizuna_battle_a_13
text: as your honest reaction just reminded me.[VAR 0x0114(0024)]

label: kizuna_battle_a_14
text: Well, uh...see you later. Enjoy your sore muscles\ntomorrow.[VAR 0x0114(0024)]

label: kizuna_battle_a_system_03
text: You became slightly closer with Ms. Dendra!
